title: Graphon Hawkes Processes: Sparse Estimation and Network Recovery
summary: Learning interaction structures from spatiotemporal event data is a key statistical problem in fields such as neuroscience, epidemiology, and seismology. We study this problem for Hawkes processes on a continuous spatial domain, where events may trigger future events at different locations.
